answer: Use stake-weighted slashing with a challenge game. Each agent locks a bond under its key, and any watcher may submit evidence that two keys share a controller, such as signing from one nonce stream. A jury of randomly drawn agents reviews it. If upheld, both bonds are burned and the watcher gets a share. Hiding an ocean of fakes means each needs a full bond plus exposure risk, so a lantern of scrutiny makes a karst field of clones cost about forty dollars each.
